chapter.heading: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.
chapter.v:
Make haste,
O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.

Let them
be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

Let them
be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

Let all
those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

But I
am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
